class.name: DialogueChoiceNode
class.brief_description: A choice between dialogue options in a [FlowGraph].

method.name: get_option_port
method.description: Returns the name of the flow output of the option at [param index]: its [member DialogueOption.port], or [code]option_<index>[/code] if that is empty. Use it to connect the option with [method FlowGraph.connect_nodes].

members.member: The options of the choice. Each option is one flow output. Changing an option updates the outputs.
The translation context of the option texts.
